name: Trees Outside Woodland Fund
summary: Grants of £10,000 to £40,000 for planting trees outside woodland in England to create or improve green spaces, open to local authorities and larger registered charities. The fund is currently closed.

eligibility.rule: Local authority based in England, or registered charity delivering the project in England
If a registered charity, have annual income or turnover over £100,000
